title: A reliable way out of a stalled connection
summary: Retry the shared connection or open the last saved roster read-only when a response is delayed.
changes: Bounded startup checks so the opening screen cannot wait indefinitely.
A Retry action that keeps the signed-in session and entered work intact.
An explicitly read-only saved-roster fallback while the shared connection is unavailable.
Profile and administrator extras that no longer block the core roster from opening.
The same restrained Apple-style light, dark and reduced-motion launch treatment.
